title: Bladder and Prostate Sonomorphology in Patients With Symptomatic Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
brief_summary: Bladder and Prostate Sonomorphology in Patients With Symptomatic Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia?
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

male patients with LUTS/BPH prostate size \> 25 g

Exclusion Criteria:

urinary retention diabetes mellitus neurologic deficit LUTS medications prior lower urinary tract surgery concomitant bladder pathology small bladder capacity (\< 150 ml) urethral stricture evident prostate carcinoma.
study_population: patient more than 50 year old who were presented with Lower urinary tract symptoms.The patients were be subjected to pelvic and transrectal ultrasound.
